title: update_read_at accepts zero/negative timestamps without validation
description: update_read_at(id, read_at_unix) accepts any i64 with no validation. Passing 0 stores read_at=0 which renders as '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z'; a negative value stores a pre-epoch timestamp. Both are nonsense for a read-receipt timestamp. The field should reject values <= 0 (or at minimum <= some reasonable epoch floor).
